title: ActorAgentList
description: actor.agent-list@1: GET /api/v1/agents for a signed-in person (capability actor.agent.manage): their own agent contacts, Vibe first. Vibe, the person's first agent, is created on this first read and cannot be deleted. Another person's agents are never in this list. The public agent-system catalog stays at GET /api/v1/agent-systems (actor.agent-list-result@2).
